description: Reference operators shipped by Orca's MuJoCo query backend. This is not a native Host or code-generator whitelist: backends can register additional operators. Bindings resolve names at prepare time; result fields map into any vendor-named compatible input field.

sample.read.description: Read metadata of the consistent physics sample.

contacts.query.description: Query contacts involving an ordered group of bound bodies or geoms. Each instance receives its own row order and recipient-side force sign. Bodies select directly owned geoms, not descendants.

options.bodies: Binding reference, exclusive with geoms, e.g. $pads
options.geoms: Binding reference, exclusive with bodies, e.g. $surfaces
options.frame: world or a site binding reference, e.g. $frame

bound_body_index.description: Zero-based index in the ordered bound body list.

bound_geom_index.description: Zero-based index in the ordered bound geom list.

counterpart_body_id.description: Opaque opposing body identifier, not geom identifier.

sensor.read.description: Copy a bound native sensor's already evaluated data (user/plugin sensors are rejected). The bound sensor determines dimension and physical semantics; reading does not run forward dynamics.

model.read.description: Read and cache an immutable model attribute when preparing the binding plan.

value.description: Body-local orientation relative to its parent, row-major rotation matrix.

rules: Fields belonging to one variable record array map to the same query and preserve row alignment.
Record counts are generated per array, not declared as separate vendor fields.
Capacity overflow fails the step; rows are never silently truncated.
Unsupported operators, result fields, bindings, and incompatible dtype/shape fail prepare before vendor instances are created.
